name: The Frozen Sin Archive
physics: Semantic Black Hole; extraction residue; what cannot be recovered
description: What was lost in the extraction. The residue that the Capital Operator Stack left behind. The meaning that was liquidated and cannot be reconstituted. Dependencies: COS, ILA.
prompt: What was destroyed, and can it be named?

constitution.ontology: Zero occurrences across the entire registry — not in titles, not in bodies, not in entity lists. This locus is seated on the Surface Map and named in the canonical, and the archive holds nothing about it at all. It is the only mapped locus of which this is true. Declared rather than quietly omitted.

gap_declaration.rule: Declared absence is inert; undeclared absence gets filled in. This locus carries no constituting document and the archive says so rather than allowing a retrieval system to supply one.
